summary: App Lock feature end-to-end tested across backend (13 pytest cases, 100% pass) and frontend (employee, customer, admin flows via Playwright). PIN setup, unlock, wrong-PIN 400 handling, lockout+429, change PIN dialog, Lock-now, settings turn-off/turn-on, keyboard & keypad input, biometric register options origin-validation, and regression (wallet/customers list) all work. Admin PIN set to 2580 during test; employee=2580, customer=2468. Minor: idle re-lock via sessionStorage simulation + reload did not trigger lock screen in Playwright; and Forgot PIN for @example.com returns 502 as expected (email provider rejects). WebAuthn virtual-authenticator biometric unlock flow not executed via browser automation (no direct CDP exposure in automation harness) — backend WebAuthn endpoints verified separately.

integration_issues.issue: Setting sessionStorage rt_unlocked_<uid> to 10 min ago and rt_hidden_at to 6 min ago then reloading does NOT show the lock screen. Per isUnlocked() logic (hidden>at && Date.now()-hidden>5min) it should relock. Real-world visibilitychange path still works via wireIdleLock; needs verification whether the on-mount check honours rt_hidden_at.

action_items: Investigate idle-relock-on-reload: AppLockGate useState(() => isUnlocked(user.id)) may be invoked with user=null on first mount so lock state is never recomputed when user hydrates from localStorage. Consider recomputing isUnlocked() in a useEffect once user is available.

Fingerprint/Face WebAuthn end-to-end flow (CDP virtual authenticator) was not exercised through browser automation harness; main agent can run a direct Playwright script locally with context.new_cdp_session if required.
@example.com Forgot-PIN returns 502 from email provider (environment-specific, not a bug) — document in UI copy or whitelist domain in preview.
critical_code_review_comments: app_lock_routes.py: AppLockGate correctly uses HTTP 400 (not 401) for wrong-PIN so axios interceptor doesn't log the user out — good.
generate_registration_options credential_id exclusion looks correct; rp_id validated against forwarded host.
isUnlocked() condition `hidden > at` could silently fail to relock after reload if visibilitychange never fires (e.g., process-killed PWA).
